mapper.update: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE name = 'DEVICES' and xtype = 'U') CREATE TABLE cts.dbo.DEVICES ( id int IDENTITY (1,1) NOT NULL, intTransport int NOT NULL, intProtocol int NOT NULL, host nvarchar(200) NOT NULL, port int NOT NULL, name nvarchar(50) NOT NULL, enabled int NOT NULL, group_id int NOT NULL, strCommunicationSettings text NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DEVICES_PK PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT DEVICES_UNIQUE UNIQUE (name) );
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DEVICES(intTransport, intProtocol, host, port, name, enabled, group_id, strCommunicationSettings) VALUES (#{intTransport}, #{intProtocol}, #{host}, #{port}, #{name}, #{enabled}, #{group_id}, #{strCommunicationSettings})
mapper.update: UPDATE DEVICES SET intTransport = #{intTransport}, intProtocol = #{intProtocol}, host = #{host}, port = #{port}, name = #{name}, enabled = #{enabled}, group_id = #{group_id}, strCommunicationSettings = #{strCommunicationSettings} WHERE id = #{id}
